purpose: Canonical build brief for Mission Control and the OpenClaw controller protocol, synthesized from controller grammar, runtime fit, dynamic-card, proof, envelope, action, WIP, gate, and evidence audits.
doctrine: Controller is 95 percent control and 5 percent status.
Proof is metering and detail drawer, not primary UI.
Receipts, read models, and proof refs define truth.
The app is a controller shell, not the brain.
Every mutating controller event requires a verified operator, app, device, and session envelope.
Incoming authority_requested is only a request. Incoming authority_granted is ignored or rejected. Authority_granted is backend-only.
Approvals, plans, generated summaries, and staged packages do not equal execution proof.

controller_shell.mission_control_role: Thin controller shell for operator input, focus, safe dispatch, dynamic cards, proof drawer, and compact meters.
controller_shell.backend_role: Owns workflow-specific copy, lane interpretation, card family, lifecycle, visibility, trust, freshness, proof refs, safe action payload refs, gate state, and receipts.
controller_shell.mac_role: Owns the shell, navigation state, generic renderer, envelope creation, safe dispatcher, local drop zone, proof drawer, compact meters, offline/bridge status, accessibility, and view preferences.
non_goals: No workflow-specific truth logic in the app.
No local Mac policy that enables protected actions by label or card id.
No direct browser, Gmail, Coupa, email, ledger, workbook, PDF export, paid marking, worker spawn, merge, push, or external-provider execution from the controller shell.
No LM-generated copy shown as truth without receipts, read models, or proof refs.

default_layout.primary_surface: Current focus and next playable control.
default_layout.secondary_surface: Composer or pad input for chat_goal and contextual questions.
default_layout.status_surface: Compact meters only, with details hidden until requested.
default_layout.history_surface: Completed, resolved, archived, and historical cards collapsed by default.
default_layout.developer_surface: Developer Proof drawer for machine contracts, raw proof refs, validation commands, hashes, SQLite refs, unsafe scans, and source metadata.

event_contracts.operator_meaning: Express a goal or ask a contextual question.
event_contracts.must_not_do: Must not stage diagnostics or packages unless the backend route returns a safe action payload.

event_contracts.operator_meaning: Run or continue a staged safe local action.
event_contracts.must_not_do: Must not execute protected business actions, worker cages, external providers, merge, push, or authority grants.

event_contracts.operator_meaning: Record an approval or review verdict.
event_contracts.must_not_do: Must not treat approval as execution proof or protected-action authority.

event_contracts.operator_meaning: Reject a pending gate, approval, or review packet.
event_contracts.must_not_do: Must not perform cleanup actions outside the backend receipt route.

event_contracts.operator_meaning: Record local candidate evidence or attach an artifact to a lane.
event_contracts.must_not_do: Must not mark paid, mutate ledgers, store raw sensitive details as memory, or call external providers.

event_contracts.operator_meaning: Ask why a gate, card, provider choice, or status exists.
event_contracts.must_not_do: Must not convert explanation text into truth or authority.

event_contracts.operator_meaning: Switch focus to a world, thread, lane, or object.
event_contracts.must_not_do: Must not mutate lane state or imply a workflow was executed.

event_contracts.operator_meaning: Stage a workflow plan without running it.
event_contracts.must_not_do: Must not execute workers, grant authority, send, submit, mutate ledgers or workbooks, export PDFs, or call providers.

event_contracts.operator_meaning: Continue a paused safe local flow.
event_contracts.must_not_do: Must not bypass blocked gates or stale proof warnings.

event_contracts.operator_meaning: Return a review packet to staging with comments.
event_contracts.must_not_do: Must not spawn a worker or mutate files outside the review decision route.

event_contracts.operator_meaning: Acknowledge and archive a card or review packet as informational.
event_contracts.must_not_do: Must not stage, execute, or promote truth.

event_contracts.operator_meaning: Pause a lane, cancel staged work, or revoke pending approval state.
event_contracts.must_not_do: Must not destructively revert unrelated work or mutate external systems.

event_contracts.operator_meaning: Open proof, receipts, hashes, source metadata, or developer diagnostics.
event_contracts.must_not_do: Must not expose raw sensitive detail by default or imply proof details are primary UI.

dynamic_card_v1.contract: Backend-authored card packet rendered by generic app components. The Mac must not switch behavior on client-specific card ids.

action_slots.rule: Mac renders enabled, disabled, proof, and danger-disabled controls from slots. It does not infer action safety from button text.

proof_object.rule: Proof details render in the drawer. Primary UI gets compact meters only.

must_never_render_as_primary: stale service-status cards without current receipt
memory candidates that do not require operator approval
gate ledger rows that do not explain a current blocker
WIP/watch metrics without a needed decision

proof_meters.principle: Proof meters translate backend proof into compact readable indicators. They are not primary UI and they open a detail drawer when the operator needs proof.

meters.when_shown: Show on cards that make factual claims, especially finance, evidence, approval, gate, review, memory, and status cards.
meters.when_hidden: Hide on pure navigation controls, empty composer state, and cards without a factual claim.
meters.when_it_opens_details: Open the proof drawer when the label is not Receipt-backed or Artifact hash, when the operator clicks the meter, or when the card is finance/payment/gate related.
meters.what_it_must_never_imply: Must never imply LM output is truth, a payment is paid, an email is sent, a provider action occurred, or an approval was executed.

meters.when_shown: Show on active, waiting, needs_operator, stale, and payment-watch cards, and on any card with stale_after or source timestamps.
meters.when_hidden: Hide on timeless shell controls, proof drawer rows without source age, and collapsed history groups unless expanded.
meters.when_it_opens_details: Open details for Needs verification, Superseded, Historical, Unknown, or when source hashes/timestamps changed.
meters.what_it_must_never_imply: Must never imply provider state is current, external systems were checked, or a stale read model can override a newer receipt.

meters.when_shown: Show beside enabled mutating controls, disabled protected controls, approval cards, review cards, gate locks, and stop/hold controls.
meters.when_hidden: Hide on read-only text, passive history rows, and non-action meter-only surfaces.
meters.when_it_opens_details: Open details when an action is disabled, approval is required, verification is missing, or a gate is blocked.
meters.what_it_must_never_imply: Must never imply authority_granted came from the app, from an LM, from incoming request text, or from operator identity alone.

meters.when_shown: Show on payment watch, evidence intake, artifact proof, review packet, memory candidate, and business-object state cards.
meters.when_hidden: Hide on cards whose only proof is developer implementation metadata and on ordinary navigation controls.
meters.when_it_opens_details: Open the proof drawer for candidate evidence, test-only evidence, rejected evidence, no evidence, or when raw_detail_available is true.
meters.what_it_must_never_imply: Must never imply raw sensitive detail is safe to display, candidate proof is verified truth, payment is paid, email is sent, or ledgers were mutated.

meters.when_shown: Show on multi-device, bridge-dependent, or handoff-sensitive packets, including the controller design brief itself.
meters.when_hidden: Hide on local-only controls and cards that do not rely on bridge parity.
meters.when_it_opens_details: Open details when local and bridge hashes differ, bridge JSON does not parse, the mount is absent, or the source is local-only.
meters.what_it_must_never_imply: Must never imply external-system sync, browser/Gmail/Coupa access, email delivery, ledger posting, or workbook mutation occurred.

meters.when_shown: Show on blocked gates, WIP bottlenecks, approval cards, review packets, protected disabled actions, unsafe-scan results, and pileup warnings.
meters.when_hidden: Hide on calm current-focus cards unless the operator opens details or a protected action is present.
meters.when_it_opens_details: Open details for Blocked, Protected, Pileup risk, Unknown, failed validation, or unsafe scan output.
meters.what_it_must_never_imply: Must never imply real-world severity beyond the backend proof, or that a protected action became safe because the UI label is calm.

visibility_rules: Active and needs_operator cards show by default only when they provide the next playable control.
Resolved cards hide by default after a receipt is recorded.
Historical cards collapse under Completed / History.
Stale cards must display Needs verification and name stale_reason.
Proof-only cards are hidden unless requested through details.
Workroom cards show only when operator_decision_required is true.
Finance payment-watch cards stay visible only while payment evidence is missing.
Payment-processing evidence becomes waiting evidence, not paid truth.
No card remains primary when replacement_card_ref or superseded_by_card_ref points to a newer receipt/card.
Machine-contract cards stay hidden in operator mode.
WIP/watch metrics are meters unless they require a concrete operator decision.
lifecycle_rules.attention_rule: A card must justify its attention cost by showing current focus, a needed decision, requested proof details, or a next playable control.

owns: evidence drop zone and local preview
limits: Does not perform protected business or external actions.
Does not hardcode client-specific cards once dynamic card v1 is stable.

ipad.role: Review and pad controller for medium-density decisions.
limits: No raw sensitive detail by default.
No protected execution or authority grant.

owns: minimal approval visibility when verification is strong
limits: No raw developer proof by default.
No protected execution or authority grant.

mac_keeps_bespoke: world/bank switcher and lane navigation state
safe action dispatcher and controller-envelope creation
evidence drop zone, file picker, and local preview
compact meters for WIP, approvals, proof, and bridge/service health
accessibility, keyboard focus, and view preferences
mac_converts_to_dynamic_cards: Live Arts MD evidence receipt card
approval request and protected gate cards
developer_proof_hidden_by_default: gate ledger rows that do not explain a current blocker
WIP/watch metrics without a needed decision
